scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=packages/protocol && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && node --test packages/protocol/tests/*.test.mjs apps/server/tests/*.test.mjs
